content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DPMU Balangir Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DPMU Balangir recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. The interview is scheduled for 11 August 2026. Candidates should attend the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Physician/ Consultant and MO MBBS posts under the District Programme Management Unit Balangir.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and have valid registration from the Odisha Council of Medical Registration. MD in Medicine or Post Graduate Diploma in Geriatric Medicine is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for all posts is 65 years. The minimum age limit is 21 years as on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Physician/ Consultant and MO MBBS posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs.86,116/- + Other allowances as per PIP, and Rs.57,409/- + Other allowances (PM-ABHIM).

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the DPMU Balangir recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to attend a walk-in interview with the required documents at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Office of CDM&PHO, Balangir.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry their application form, self-attested copies of all supportive documents, original documents, ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificate (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contract-based.
